step: mix with clay or pigment, coat

steps.what: coating clay and precipitated calcium carbonate pigment
steps.note: The dissolved casein and pigment are mixed to a coating of about 38 percent solids at pH 9 to 10.5.

steps.name: roll coat
steps.note: A roll coater lays the coating on one side of the moving paper web.
The paper is dried in the usual way, hung in festoons.

steps.name: supercalender
steps.note: Supercalendering presses the dried coat to a smooth, glossy label surface.

processing.text: This is the paper coating; leather is coated with casein and pigment too, then glazed, which this source does not describe.

sources.text: The steps and the figures from the example in this one patent, so they are one mill's method of its time; the alkali and its amount for dissolving the casein are not fully legible there.
